description: 한국전기안전공사_발변전소 용접 검사 개선조치요구 원별 연도별 통계 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전기안전공사. 이 데이터는 발변전소 용접 검사 개선조치 요구사항을 발전원별(화력, 복합, 연료전지)과 연도별(2016년 ~ 2019년6월까지)로 제공합니다. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
